name: ta.kc
notes: Official v6 re-implementation: basis = ta.ema(src, length); span = ta.tr when useTrueRange else (high - low); rangeEma = ta.ema(span, length); [basis, basis + rangeEma * mult, basis - rangeEma * mult]. Bar 1 gaps below the previous close so ta.tr (0.6) differs from high - low (0.4). Corrected ta.ema warm-up (SMA seed, na until the length-th valid bar; see docs/ECOSYSTEM.md): basis and rangeEma are na on bars 0-1 and seed at bar 2 (SMA of the first 3 valid values).
